description_target.target_text: Isolated rooms (min-size 0-components) → green, merged multi-room chains → yellow

racket_target.raw_code: (rule! (lambda (g) (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))) (let* ((inverted (cellmap g (r c v) (if (zero? v) 1 0))) (comps (objects inverted 0)) (min-size (min-of obj-size comps))) (for/fold ((gg g)) ((comp comps)) (let ((color (if (= (obj-size comp) min-size) 3 4))) (for/fold ((ggg gg)) ((cell (obj-cells comp))) (set-cell ggg (first cell) (second cell) color))))))))
